risks.title: Failure to recruit and retain senior management and key employees
risks.score_rationale: Positioned first in risk factors summary. Strong language used ('failure to successfully recruit and retain', 'critical to the success'). Intense competition and legal uncertainty regarding non-compete clauses increase severity.

risks.title: Loss of relationships with insurance carriers or clients
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned prominently in risk factors. Strong language ('potential loss', 'failure to maintain', 'dependent upon a limited number'). Revenue concentration from top clients represents material risk.

risks.title: Errors in underwriting models and reputational impact
risks.score_rationale: Included in business and industry risks. Direct language ('errors in, or ineffectiveness of', 'harmed'). Impact on reputation and relationships with trading partners clearly indicated.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection risks
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section on risks related to intellectual property, data privacy, and cybersecurity. Strong language ('breaches in security', 'significant system or network disruption', 'cyber incidents and cyberattacks'). Material operational impact potential.

risks.title: Economic conditions and market cyclicality
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in business risks ('cyclicality of, and the economic conditions'). Moderate language but broad scope ('markets in which we operate'). Impact on insurer underwriting capacity is key factor.

risks.title: Regulatory and legal risks
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section on legal and regulatory risks. General language covering broad spectrum ('evolving governmental regulations', 'legal proceedings', 'governmental inquiries'). Material potential impact.

risks.title: Acquisition integration and new product development
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in business risks ('unsatisfactory evaluation of potential acquisitions or the failure to successfully integrate acquired businesses and/or introduce new products'). Language indicates execution risk ('failure to successfully').

ai_positioning.summary: Ryan Specialty does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F disclosure. The company focuses on specialty insurance intermediation, underwriting models, and traditional digital transformation initiatives.
